question: What is the meaning of cost in relation to technical features?
description: The cost in relation to technical features refers to the expenses associated with the production, construction, demolition, transportation, and storage of materials and components. These costs are influenced by factors such as material type, material mass, and the technical details of the components, such as connection type and component structural performance. The economic costs are analyzed through Life Cycle Cost (LCC) and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), considering the special aspects of circular projects.
